constraints.note: Ultra-lightweight conversational model (0.88B params). Excellent for rapid iteration, edge deployment, and consumer GPUs. Has experimental reasoning capabilities. Note: 1024 token context limit and tokenizer quirks with newlines.

quirks.newlines: Treated as spaces or stripped—use simple prompts without complex formatting
quirks.punctuation: Some punctuation (e.g., ?) may display oddly; fixed in Opus 2.0
quirks.accuracy: Lower factual accuracy than larger models; best for creative/conversational tasks
